brief: One drawer and one spike, both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching.

requirements.requirement: One drawer (notch drawer) and one spike both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching
requirements.evidence: Spike at junction 0,0|0,1|1,0 (corner of cells 0,1 and 1,0) and notch drawer frame at 1,1 (empty cell wedged between those same two cells) share the same vertex; check_build meshClash clear shows they coexist touching without clash.

finish.summary: Built L of three full bases to create interior corner, placed spike at 0,0|0,1|1,0 and notch drawer (hex-bin-notch-mf-solid) at 1,1 which is clamped between the same two bases and meets the spike at the same corner point; verified mesh clear.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
